criteria.title: Catalog
criteria.text: The page lists the six courses, each with its name, schedule and number of available seats.

criteria.title: Enroll
criteria.text: Clicking "Enroll" on a course with seats adds it to "My courses" and decreases its available seats by exactly one.

criteria.title: No duplicates
criteria.text: After enrolling in a course, its button reads "Enrolled" and is disabled, and the course appears only once in "My courses".

criteria.title: Full courses
criteria.text: A course with 0 seats shows "Full" and cannot be enrolled in.

criteria.title: Schedule clash
criteria.text: Enrolling in a course that overlaps one already in "My courses" is rejected with a message that names the conflicting course. Seats and "My courses" do not change.

criteria.title: Drop
criteria.text: Clicking "Drop" removes the course from "My courses" and gives its seat back.

criteria.title: Search
criteria.text: Typing in the search box filters the catalog by course name, ignoring upper and lower case. Clearing it shows all courses again.

criteria.title: Persistence
criteria.text: Enrollments and seat counts survive a page reload.

criteria.title: No runtime errors
criteria.text: Using the app never throws an uncaught JavaScript error.
